lines.en: Heavy footsteps, creaking.
Chewing on rotten fingers.
Dragging its body on broken rocks.
Starving, glancing at your footsteps.

lines.zh: 啃食腐肉的声音清晰可闻。
lines.en: Hearing the crunch of decayed flesh.
Approaching you slowly.
Weakly crying for help.
Roaming the wilderness at night.
Chewing on rotten bones.
Scanning for food traces.

lines.zh: 拖着一只断腿往屋里挪。
lines.en: Dragging one broken leg toward the house.

lines.zh: 攥着半截铁管走过废墟。
lines.en: Crossing the ruins with half an iron pipe.
Leaning against a wall, vacant eyes.
Slumped on the ground, limbs weak.
Staring into the distance with lifeless eyes.
Chewing on its own mutilated limbs.

lines.zh: 摇摇晃晃地站着，支撑不住。
lines.en: Shakily standing, unable to hold on.

lines.zh: 我压低嗓子，不想引来尸群。
lines.en: I keep quiet so the horde won't hear.
Leaning against a tree trunk, dejected.
Feeling around for food.
Vacant eyes wandering around.
Low head, as if pondering.

lines.zh: 你身上没有咬痕，运气不错。
lines.en: No bite marks on you. Lucky.

lines.zh: 我先看你的牙，再看你的眼。
lines.en: I check your teeth first, then your eyes.
Empty eyes looking at you.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在墙上，我盯着它。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the wall and I watch it.
Eyes flickering, seemingly thinking.

lines.zh: 盯着你看，似乎认出了你。
lines.en: Staring at you, as if recognizing you.
Vacant eyes, staring at you.
Sharp eyes, staring at you.
Empty eyes, staring at you.
Vacant eyes, staring at you.
The wound hurts so much!
Find me some medicine!

lines.zh: 旧伤从绷带底下渗出来。
lines.en: The old wound seeps out from under the bandage.

lines.zh: 撑了这么多天，就到这里。
lines.en: I lasted this many days. This is it.
Under the bandages, the bleeding has not stopped.

lines.zh: 我把水壶递过去，手在抖。
lines.en: I hold out my canteen, my hand shaking.

lines.zh: 第十一个冬天，我还没死。
lines.en: An eleventh winter, and I am still alive.

lines.zh: 别丢下我，我还能自己走。
lines.en: Don't leave me, I can still walk.
This wound is so painful!
Please help me!

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者伸出枯手，试图抓住你。
lines.en: Survivor zombie extends its rotting hand, trying to grab you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，僵尸幸存者盯着你。
lines.en: Sibilant sound, survivor zombie staring at you.

lines.zh: 饥饿的幸存者啃咬着干瘪的嘴唇。
lines.en: Survivor bites on its shriveled lips, hungry.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者发出微弱的求救声。
lines.en: Weak, zombie survivor's plea.

lines.zh: 你被幸存者的目光所吸引。
lines.en: You're drawn to survivor's gaze.

lines.zh: 幸存者用它腐烂的手指指向你。
lines.en: Survivor points at you with its rotting fingers.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者啃着腐烂的肉。
lines.en: Survivor zombie chews on rotting flesh.

lines.zh: 你看到幸存者眼中闪烁的求生欲望。
lines.en: Survivor's eyes flicker with survival desire.

lines.zh: 幸存者发出痛苦的呻吟声。
lines.en: Survivor gives a pained moan.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者渴望得到你的帮助。
lines.en: Survivor zombie craves your help.

lines.zh: 你撞上了僵尸幸存者，它正四处寻找食物。
lines.en: You collide with survivor zombie scavenging for food.

lines.zh: 幸存者从你身边走过，你感觉到它的存在。
lines.en: Survivor passes by, you feel its presence.

lines.zh: 你在昏暗中撞上了僵尸幸存者。
lines.en: You collide with survivor zombie in the dim light.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者挡住了你的去路。
lines.en: Survivor zombie blocks your path.

lines.zh: 你撞上了一个正在进食的幸存者。
lines.en: You collide with a feeding survivor.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者突然出现在你的视线中。
lines.en: Survivor zombie suddenly appears in your sight.

lines.zh: 你试图避开僵尸幸存者的视线。
lines.en: You try to avoid survivor zombie's gaze.

lines.zh: 你和僵尸幸存者在狭窄的空间里碰面。
lines.en: You meet survivor zombie in a narrow space.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者在你周围徘徊。
lines.en: Survivor zombie loiters around you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了正在巡逻的僵尸幸存者。
lines.en: You collide with a patrolling survivor zombie.

lines.zh: 幸存者发出求偶的嘶吼声。
lines.en: Survivor lets out a mating scream.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者用腐烂的双手试图抓住同类。
lines.en: Survivor zombie tries to grab a mate with its rotting hands.

lines.zh: 你看到两只僵尸幸存者在搏斗。
lines.en: You see two survivor zombies fighting.

lines.zh: 幸存者们发出微弱的交配叫声。
lines.en: Survivors emit weak mating calls.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者相互追逐，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Survivor zombies chase each other for a mate.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者在黑暗中发出求偶声。
lines.en: Survivor zombie emits a mating call in the dark.

lines.zh: 你听到了僵尸幸存者之间的交配声音。
lines.en: You hear mating sounds between survivor zombies.

lines.zh: 两只僵尸幸存者交缠在一起。
lines.en: Two survivor zombies tangle together.

lines.zh: 你看到两只僵尸幸存者交配。
lines.en: You see two survivor zombies copulate.

lines.zh: 僵尸幸存者发出哀嚎般的求偶声。
lines.en: Survivor zombies emit wailing mating calls.
Eats non-stop after picking up food.

lines.zh: 闻到食物气息，立即扑过去。
lines.en: Sniffs out food and rushes over.
Swallows food immediately upon finding it.
Enjoying the dried food.
Taking big bites of the apple.

lines.zh: 啃咬着食物，不放过任何机会。
lines.en: Chewing on food, seizing any chance.

lines.zh: 在草地上找寻可口的食物。
lines.en: Searching for good food on the grass.

lines.zh: 捡起食物，迅速消失在视野中。
lines.en: Quickly disappears after picking up food.

lines.zh: 看到食物，就毫不犹豫地吃。
lines.en: Eats immediately upon seeing food.

lines.zh: 捡起一块面包，咬了又咬。
lines.en: Bites on a piece of bread.
Locks onto target, with a fierce gaze.
Survivors have teeth too; do not push me.
Eyes shine with the discovery of prey.
Locks onto player, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 观察四周，寻找可攻击的目标。
lines.en: Scans surroundings for a target to attack.

lines.zh: 锁定远处目标，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: Locks onto distant target, inching closer.

lines.zh: 注意到了玩家，悄悄接近。
lines.en: Notices player, creeping closer.

lines.zh: 目光锁定目标，缓缓接近。
lines.en: Locks onto target, inching closer.

lines.zh: 观察到目标，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: Observes target, preparing to attack.
Aims at player, preparing a surprise attack.
You have no bandage on those hands.
Was that scream yours?
Living one, put your hands up first.

lines.zh: 这堆罐头是我先翻到的。
lines.en: I found these cans first.
You are bleeding. Stay back.
Opens mouth, revealing sharp teeth.
Hisses, threatening the target.

lines.zh: 用嘶吼吸引注意，准备攻击。
lines.en: Draws attention with a growl, ready to attack.
Warns with a snarl, alerting the target.

lines.zh: 盯着目标，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: Stares at target, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中带着威胁，步步紧逼。
lines.en: Hisses with threat, closing in.

lines.zh: 发出警告，让目标知道危险。
lines.en: Issues a warning, making the target aware of danger.

lines.zh: 警告声中带着警告，步步紧逼。
lines.en: Snarls warnings, closing in.
Warning sounds, target backs off.
Issues a warning, alerting the target.

lines.zh: 我腿上这道口子，是被咬的。
lines.en: This gash on my leg came from a bite.
I don't want to fight. Don't make me.
Half a loaf if you walk away.
I swing the pipe when I reach three.
Don't point that gun at me.
These clothes are still my own.

lines.zh: 你听见我说话，就别靠太近。
lines.en: You hear me talk, so keep your distance.
I can still stand, before I turn.
Chomp chomp...
Snarl snarl...
Rumble rumble...
Starving like this, teeth beat knives.
Crunch crunch...
Sssss, good prey!
Snap snap...
Sssss, my territory!

lines.zh: 我把铁管横挡在门槛上。
lines.en: I brace the iron pipe across the doorway.
The pipe rings off your shoulder plate.
I shove you back into the wall.
That punch hurt me too.
I'm taking your canteen. Don't blame me.
Save it. Don't make me bite.
A knee comes up. Keep your footing.
I was aiming for the door, not you.
Sssss, someone’s here!
Sssss, new food’s here!
Sssss, follow me...

lines.zh: 我埋的绊线，就在你脚边。
lines.en: The tripwire I set is by your feet.
Sssss, hide!
Sssss, run!

lines.zh: 楼下有脚步，我把门顶住。
lines.en: Footsteps below; I wedge the door shut.
I stamp out the last piece of candle.
Survivor number six, still alive.

lines.zh: 烟里走出个拿铁管的人。
lines.en: A figure with an iron pipe steps out of the smoke.
There is still a living breath in this building.
I have hidden here three nights.
Who's out there? Give me a name.
Don't kick that door. I'm inside.
Ouch! Burned by fire!
My old gun is still loaded.
Drowned and freezing!

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡嗡响，我找不到北。
lines.en: My ears ring and I cannot tell which way is north.

lines.zh: 袖子上穿了个洞，血流下来。
lines.en: A hole in my sleeve, and blood running down.
Hit by magic!
Starving to death!

lines.zh: 我手里那根铁管把我害了。
lines.en: The iron pipe in my hand is what did this to me.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我踩空了。
lines.en: There is nothing underfoot; I step into air.
